first_inning_and_inning_markets#inn_misf.detail: Verified on Kalshi's markets endpoint (2026-11-08): KXMLBINNINGTOTAL lists Over 0.5 and Over 1.5 for innings 1-9, and KXMLBINNINGWIN lists team-more and tie for innings 1-9. No extra-inning strike is listed. The 3rd-inning text has the same Fair Price called-game clause; only the 9th-inning text adds the home-team-not-batting clause. Record changes: mlb.f3_split audited IRRELEVANT and removed from stage s3 and the PA dataset. f3_split is now attached to first5_markets, which holds KXMLBF3. mlb.tto is re-audited KEEP_SECONDARY for innings 3-7. Added stage s6 (middle-inning index), a regime-switch interaction, and the verified strike list in the contract text.

hitter_hits_and_total_bases#hits_hrr_cha.detail: Auditor was right: the chain only output RBI opportunity. Patch input_patches/MLB_a.json now redefines mlb.pa_base_out_state_chain (label, mechanism, rationale, measurement) to give three outputs per PA: (a) runners/outs when he bats; (b) P(he scores | each on-base outcome), continuing the chain through the following batters; (c) expected runs. The runs leg is P(run) = P(HR) + sum_o P(o) x P(score | o, state). Stage s5 of hitter_hits_and_total_bases cites output (b). The archetype patch sets the chain secondary and rbi/run_scoring_opportunity to context.

hitter_home_runs#hr_opp_starter_change.detail: Checked the KXMLBHR rules text: fair price applies only when the named hitter is scratched, does not start or gets no PA. An opposing-starter change leaves the market live. mlb.f5_starter_change_risk is attached to hitter_home_runs and staged in s3, with a conditional interaction alongside relief_hr_vulnerability_by_hand. Patch MLB_a: mlb.pitcher_hr_vulnerability measurement is now a mixture over the announced and replacement starters for opposing-hitter props. mlb.f5_starter_change_risk mechanism and measurement are generalised to output the replacement distribution.

hitter_rbis_runs_sb#rbi_runs_scope.detail: series_assignment already files KXMLBSB and KXMLBRBI here, and an earlier pass audited run_scoring_opportunity IRRELEVANT. Verified online on 2026-11-08: Kalshi's Sports series list has 166 KXMLB series and none settles on a batter's runs scored. Runs appear only inside KXMLBHRR. Settled KXMLBRBI markets show 1+/2+/3+ rungs and KXMLBSB shows 1+ only. These facts are written into the contract settlement_definition and the run_scoring_opportunity audit.

offfield_markets#off_unstaged_inputs.detail: Catalog-level fix via archetype_patches/MLB_a.json for offfield_markets. It detaches manager_wins_over_expectation, sale_process_stage_hazard, mlbb_team_rating_series_format, manager_candidate_selection_signal and roster_moves (all audited IRRELEVANT). It relabels and retargets the archetype to the only live series, KXMLBFODTEAMS (Field of Dreams teams), and rewrites its mechanism. offfield_base_rate and quote_history become context. It attaches labor_stoppage_regime and news_source_reliability_score, which are staged in s2/s4 and audited. The detached inputs stay attached where their series now live: manager_wins in season_leaders_and_awards, the candidate signal in transactions. Sale and esports are out of scope.

pitcher_outs#outs_hazard_naming.detail: There is now one exit-hazard id, mlb.sp_hook_hazard_curve; earlier patches made sp_workload and exit_boundary_mass readouts of it and leash a component of it. This pass fixes the residue. The archetype patch detaches mlb.leash from pitcher_strikeouts, pitcher_outs, pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks, first5_markets and counting specials. It attaches sp_hook_hazard_curve to first5_markets, pitcher_outs and pitcher_earned_runs_hits_walks. In the records, leash is replaced by the hazard in every stage, coverage, interaction and data feed (first5 s1/s2 included). first5_markets carries the hazard in new_inputs, and its leash audit is DUPLICATE_OF the hazard.

pitcher_strikeouts#ks_talent_prior_gap.detail: Added the new input mlb.pitcher_k_talent_prior to pitcher_strikeouts. It blends a Steamer/ZiPS K% prior with a pitch-shape whiff grade. Old samples are down-weighted after an arsenal change. Rookies use MiLB-translated projections. The posterior shrinks with k = 150 BF. It is staged in s3 and talent_strength coverage, with a new dataset (projection vintages need own capture) and a piecewise interaction with pitch_type_whiff and k_rates.

player_participation#pp_cba_lockout.detail: Verified that the CBA expires at 11:59 p.m. ET on Dec 1 2026, with a lockout widely expected. mlb.labor_stoppage_regime (identical definition) is attached to player_participation and staged in new stage s7 (postseason and labour branches). It is added to situational coverage and the transactions dataset feed. The contract treatment of cancelled games is still unseen (the KXMLBSTART terms PDF is blocked from here) and stays a contract dependency, not an input gap.

player_participation#pp_opp_starter_vint.detail: Added the new input mlb.opposing_probable_starter_vintage to player_participation. It takes 30-minute snapshots of StatsAPI probablePitcher (id, pitchHand, first-seen and change timestamps) and mixes over opposing hand using f5_starter_change_risk. Manager-specific start rates by hand are shrunk with k = 30. It is staged in s2 and s7. opponent_matchup coverage changes from GAP to COVERED, with a conditional interaction with platoon and playing_time_role.

player_participation#pp_postseason_regim.detail: Auditor was right: postseason_roster_reset_eligibility is a team-strength delta. Added the new input mlb.postseason_round_roster_membership. It is player-level: P(on the round's 26-man roster) is known (1/0) after submission. A player removed for injury is ineligible for the rest of the round and the next. Before submission it is a logistic on prior-round roster, end-of-season active status, position-group WAR rank, IL times activation probability and platoon need, fitted on 2012-2025 rosters. It replaces the old input in stage s7, coverage, interaction and feeds. The old input is detached from player_participation and audited IRRELEVANT.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_electorate.detail: Verified online: the Rivera/Hoffman awards are voted by a panel of about six retired relievers (5-3-1). Comeback Player is voted by 30 MLB.com beat reporters. The Hank Aaron Award combines a Hall of Fame panel with a fan vote. Gold Gloves combine managers and coaches with SDI at about 25%. BBWAA ballots are MVP 14-9-8..., Cy 7-4-3-2-1, ROY/MOTY 5-3-1. Added new inputs mlb.award_electorate_procedure and mlb.award_fan_vote_popularity, plus new stage s9 and two interactions. Patch: award_vote_rank_model pools coefficients only within one electorate class. It also corrects a catalog error: ROY was listed as top-5; it is a 3-place ballot. New finding: the BBWAA added a Relief Pitcher of the Year in 2026, so which Reliever award settles is ambiguous; this is recorded in the contract variants.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_eoty_elect.detail: Verified from MLB announcements: Executive of the Year is voted by the 30 clubs before the postseason, with no public ballots (winners since 2018 include Arnold in 2024 and 2025). Added the new input mlb.executive_award_team_improvement: wins change, wins over projection, playoff flag, payroll efficiency and net fWAR of acquisitions, fitted as a conditional logit on 2018-2025 winners. It is staged in s9, and the contract variant is rewritten. manager_wins_over_expectation is patched to be manager-only.

season_leaders_and_awards#lea_narrative_.detail: The measurement was already patched to pre-registered statistics-based flags (milestone list, comeback, first-year, positional scarcity, team surprise) with a per-electorate fit and a drop rule. This pass patches the mlb.award_narrative mechanism and rationale to match: flags are computed from official statistics at the ballot deadline, never from media mentions, and each is kept only if it adds likelihood. The archetype patch detaches and re-attaches award_narrative in season_leaders_and_awards with a new why naming the flags.

unreg:pitch_velocity_extremes#velo_kxmlb.detail: The listing is verified: KXMLBSTAT has 11 events, 8 of them non-velocity. Their inputs exist and are staged (leaguewide_rare_game_event_hazard, any_pitcher_season_wins_threshold, joint_season_hr_sb_distribution in s6). The archetype patch now relabels, retargets and re-describes the archetype as velocity plus KXMLBSTAT season feats, and the record summary states the mismatch. But the 8 events are still filed in the velocity archetype rather than a dedicated season-feats archetype. Creating new archetype keys or re-filing series is not possible in this pass.

unreg:player_and_team_counting_specials#.detail: The catalog input list is corrected via archetype patch. It detaches the 7 departed-series inputs (attached to season_futures and season_leaders_and_awards by patch and record) plus plate_discipline, sb_context, baserunning, umpire and leash, leaving 24 inputs. Roles are adjusted, and the label, target, contract_types and mechanism are rewritten for the 5 filed series. 15 family inputs are attached. The split into separate postseason-count, player-exposure and streak archetypes that the catalog_action asks for is not done: it needs new archetype keys and series re-filing, which are outside this pass.
